Topology.title: Hierarchical Network Architecture
Topology.Description: A secure hierarchical network design for a government entity, including an Internet Edge, a three-tier data center, and WAN connectivity for remote sites.
Topology.Summary: The topology includes an Internet Edge zone with a firewall and application-layer security, a three-tier data center, and WAN connections to regional and branch offices. Remote sites have local routing and switching.

Control.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
Control.Evidence: The topology includes an 'Asset Management' zone with an 'Asset Management System' node, which implies the presence of an asset inventory system.

Control.title: Document Data Flows
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Data Flow Documentation' zone with a 'Data Flow Documentation System' node, which implies the presence of a system for documenting data flows.

Control.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Non-Production Zone' and a 'Data Center' zone, which implies that data processing and storage are segmented based on sensitivity.

Control.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Server Firewall' node in the 'Data Center' zone, which implies that firewalls are implemented on servers.

Control.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Server' node in the 'Internet Edge' zone, which implies that trusted DNS servers are configured.

Control.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Remote Access VPN Gateway' node in the 'Internet Edge' zone, which implies that MFA is required for remote network access.

Control.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Filter' node in the 'Internet Edge' zone, which implies that DNS filtering services are used.

Control.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Web Proxy' node in the 'Internet Edge' zone, which implies that network-based URL filters are maintained and enforced.

Control.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
Control.Evidence: The topology includes multiple zones (Internet Edge, Data Center, Regional Office, Branch Office, Management Zone, Non-Production Zone, External Testing Zone) and a hierarchical network design, which implies a secure network architecture.

Control.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
Control.Evidence: The topology includes an 'IaC Tools' zone with an 'IaC Tool' node, which implies that network infrastructure is managed securely using IaC.

Control.title: Centralize Network Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA)
Control.Evidence: The topology includes an 'Identity Server' node in the 'Management Zone', which implies centralized network AAA.

Control.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Remote Access VPN Gateway' node in the 'Internet Edge' zone, which implies that remote devices utilize a VPN and connect to the enterprise's AAA infrastructure.

Control.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Detection Solution
Control.Evidence: The topology includes an 'NIDS' node in the 'Internet Edge' zone, which implies that a network intrusion detection solution is deployed.

Control.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
Control.Evidence: The topology includes multiple firewalls (Firewall, Data Center Firewall, Server Firewall) and links between zones, which implies traffic filtering between network segments.

Control.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Remote Access VPN Gateway' node and an 'Identity Server' node, which implies that access control for remote assets is managed.

Control.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Log Collection System' node in the 'Management Zone', which implies that network traffic flow logs are collected.

Control.title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Non-Production Zone' and a 'Data Center' zone, which implies that production and non-production systems are separated.

Control.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Penetration Testing Host' node in the 'External Testing Zone' and a 'Penetration Testing Management System' node, which implies that periodic external penetration tests are performed.
